Aug 2024 • Family
Many shops in Da Nang do not have air conditioning, so I went all the way from Mee Khe Beach to visit an NCT store that has air conditioning. But it is hot. Apparently the air conditioning is broken. Best burgers in town
Jun 2018 • Couples
Love the hamburgers here. They have several choices - I like the one with the burger patty and a generous topping of sliced avocado. You can have fries and a drink included in the combo, which makes a perfect-sized dinner - and cheap, too! You even get a carafe of ice water at no additional charge. 

Staff is efficient and friendly. Visited this place several times and love it. They have another branch in Son Tra District, but I think that this is the better of the two - it's cleaner, has a bit nicer atmosphere and enough parking. 

The burgers are American style and they do them perfectly. Fries are made with a hint of garlic - yum. This place is a winner.

Best burger in Da Nang, for sure.
May 2018 • Friends
Have a craving for a burger? 
Look no further. 
Here’s the most delicious burger,
Da Nang had ever heard of.

I think so, anyway.

I had a cheeseburger with an egg and a small order of fries. The burger was big and juicy and had yummy condiments. The fries had rosemary and garlic (or something) and were quite delightful. I was pretty stuffed when I left.

There is not a ton of seating, so you may have to take away or wait for a table.

Also, according to my friend, the bacon was not super crispy, so if you desire crisp bacon, you may want to skip it altogether and save a 20,000 dong.

Could be better
May 2018 • Solo
Being a burger guy, I can say that the burgers tasted quite nice, but there is a room for improvement. I went there twice to try different burgers and give an honest review. Even though their bacon was delicious, it was a bit rubbery.  Also, my burger was falling apart after a couple of bites. It can be avoided, if you simply use your fork and knife. However, I believe that the burger should never be cut. Neither the place itself was fancy, nor spacious. It gets pretty packed up every time, so I hope you will be lucky to get a seat. But the price beats it all I guess; especially if you are a tight budget.
